criteria.criterion: Never label a package REVIEWED if any required review holds or is absent; present owner outcomes, value and limitations.
New PRs at/after cutover require exactly one base-pinned reviewed packet; fail closed on missing paths/pin/checker and keep legacy PRs outside this new check.
Run trusted scripts only, never run candidate checkout scripts, preserve no elevated write credentials; explicitly distinguish PR check from enforced branch restrictions.
Preserve all pre-existing product gates, PR428/429, Brain/Barbecue, Based Cooking STOP and one bounded app-only checkpoint.

constraints: No claim of independent reviews or comparative reliability

knowledge.software_data: Adversarial negative tests and live activation distinguish procedural installation from end-to-end behavior
